name: Castle Park
description: A castle-themed event venue in Lindon with upper and lower ballrooms, gardens, and a castle and gazebo for ceremonies; packages include tables, chairs, linens, decorations and a wedding planner.
seatedText:
96 (Venue & Decor package)
Upper 120 / Lower 150
Lower 200 with Large Party package

Accessibility options > Wheelchair acces.wording: Ramp entrance and accessible walkway to the elevator

Audio/Visual > TV.wording: TVs in both ballrooms and the upper groom's room

Features > Event coordinator.wording: Venue wedding planner with every package

Features > Outside catering allowed.wording: Self-catering or any caterer at no extra charge

Features > Sparklers allowed.wording: Sparklers, bubbles or bells for the exit (every package); not lit indoors or over carpet

Decor > Draping / chair covers.wording: Lights and drapes packages: Lower Ballroom $600, Upper Ballroom $700

Decor > Signs / easels.wording: Floor easel; easel and sign-in table with linen

Other > Drink / beverage station.wording: Bar package $950: licensed bartender for 3 hours, tables and linens

items.label: Description
items.value: A castle-themed event venue in Lindon with upper and lower ballrooms, gardens, and a castle and gazebo for ceremonies; packages include tables, chairs, linens, decorations and a wedding planner.

items.label: Address
items.value: 110 South Main Street, Lindon, UT 84042

items.label: Style words
items.value:
High class
Castle

items.label: Price
items.value: One ballroom $1,825–$3,595; both ballrooms (Large Party) $6,045–$8,675

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Same-space ceremony package — $550
Castle or gazebo ceremony package — $775
Castle or gazebo ceremony decor package — $515
Lights/drapes package — $600 (Lower Ballroom) / $700 (Upper Ballroom)
Wedding planner ceremony management — $625
Wedding planner reception management — $975
DJ/MC package — $1,175
Alcohol bar package — $950
Additional hour (one ballroom) — $275 before midnight / $325 after midnight
Additional hour (Large Party) — $520 before midnight / $640 after midnight
All day (5 hours added) — $675 (one ballroom) / $975 (Large Party)
Exclusive entire-property rental — 10% off venue rental

items.label: Deposit
items.value:
Deposit: 50% of the reservation, up to $1,500 (one venue space) or $2,500 (two spaces)
Middle payment of 50% for events over $4,500
Final payment due 30 days before the event
Security/cleaning deposit only for very large or teen events
Free 5-day courtesy hold by text

items.value: Upper or Lower Ballroom

items.label: Outdoors
items.value: Gazebo and private garden

items.value:

items.label: Upper Ballroom
items.value: Seated: 120 · Setting: indoor · Notes: white Chiavari chairs; balcony; groom's/media room

items.label: Lower Ballroom
items.value: Seated: 150 · Seated large party: 200 · Setting: indoor · Notes: black Chiavari chairs; grassy area to the west; required for high school dances

items.label: Castle
items.value: Setting: outdoor · Use: ceremony (package $775)

items.value: Setting: outdoor · Use: ceremony (package $775)

items.value: Setting: outdoor · Use: Large Party package

items.label: Same space ceremony
items.value: Price: $550 · Includes: 90-minute rehearsal; 80-chair setup; one changeover

items.label: Castle or gazebo ceremony
items.value: Price: $775 · Includes: 90-minute rehearsal; 80-chair setup; PA speaker and microphone; 2-hour block

items.label: Castle or gazebo ceremony decor
items.value: Price: $515 · Includes: backdrop; 40 chair sashes; easel and sign-in table with linen

items.label: Rain plan
items.value: Castle/gazebo ceremonies move indoors in bad weather; no refunds or delays.

items.label: Bridal room
items.value: Brides room in both ballrooms

items.label: Groom's room
items.value: Upper includes grooms/Media room

items.label: Rooms
items.value:
Bride's room (each ballroom)
Groom's/media room (Upper Ballroom only)

items.label: Linens included
items.value: Tufted linens for standard tables

items.label: Cleanup crew
items.value: Not listed by the venue

items.label: Event coordinator
items.value: Venue wedding planner with every package

items.label: Included items
items.value:
Tufted tablecloths for all tables (white-ivory or black)
Non-flower centerpieces
Colored table runners
Standard backdrop
Chair sashes for every other chair
Sparklers, bubbles or bells for the exit
Floor easel
Twelve 60" round tables and six serving/decor tables (one ballroom)
Chiavari chairs
TV/DVD player

items.label: Staff & coordination
items.value:
Wedding planner included in every package (planning meeting; manages room setup and decorations)
On-site staff member during rental; checks in every 45-60 minutes
Renter must name a Day-of Coordinator
Wedding planner reception management — $975
Wedding planner ceremony management — $625

items.label: Setup & cleanup
items.value:
Venue staff clear linens and decor and do the deep cleaning
Renter/caterer must bus tables, bag trash and clean the kitchen

items.value: Non-floral centerpieces

items.value: Standard backdrop; ceremony decor package $515

Castle or gazebo ceremony decor package (backdrop, 40 chair sashes, easel, sign-in table with linen) — $515
Lights/drapery package — $600 (Lower Ballroom) / $700 (Upper Ballroom)
Alcohol bar package (licensed bartender for 3 hours, tables, linens, cups) — $950
Custom florals (on request, price not stated)
Serving utensils and place settings (price not stated)

items.value:
Gardens, castle and gazebo (ceremony sites)
Upper Ballroom balcony
Lower Ballroom grassy area
Playground (adult supervision required)
Photography session on the grounds (must be scheduled)
DJ/MC package — $1,175

items.label: Cake table
items.value: Not listed by the venue

items.label: Drink / beverage station
items.value: Bar package $950: licensed bartender for 3 hours, tables and linens

items.value: Not listed by the venue

items.label: Outside catering allowed
items.value: Self-catering or any caterer at no extra charge

items.label: Catering
items.value:
Outside caterers allowed, no fee
Self-catering allowed
Royal Catering available through Castle Park
Caterers must follow the caterer information sheet

items.label: Kitchen / prep
items.value:
Warming kitchen only (no stove; burners disabled)
2 ovens, microwave, ice machine, triple refrigerator, freezer, sinks
Kitchen shared between the two ballrooms, divided by space

items.label: Alcohol
items.value:
Alcohol allowed
Castle Park bartender required: bar package — $950 (client supplies alcohol)
No outside bartenders

items.label: Sparklers allowed
items.value: Sparklers, bubbles or bells for the exit (every package); not lit indoors or over carpet

items.label: Sparklers
items.value:
Yes
Sparklers, bubbles or bells for the exit included in every package
Not to be lit inside or over carpet

items.label: Times
items.value:
6-hour block between 4pm and 11pm (start at 4pm or 5pm)
Large Party: 5pm-1am (setup from 3pm)
Extra hours available; stays past 2am need management approval

items.label: Rental length
items.value: 6-8 hours

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
Only Castle Park bartenders
Large or amplified bands, or full DJ setups, require both ballrooms
Outside DJs must use the house sound system
No arrival before the rental start time
No moving chairs between ballrooms
No rice, confetti, poppers, silly string or glitter (cleaning charge)
Kitchen must be left clean by caterers

items.label: Wheelchair accessible
items.value: Ramp entrance and accessible walkway to the elevator

items.label: Elevator
items.value: Elevator

items.label: ADA restrooms
items.value: Not listed by the venue

items.label: Accessible parking
items.value: Not listed by the venue

items.label: Accessibility
items.value:
Elevator
Ramp entrance at the west end of the main building
Handicap-marked walkway to the elevator

items.label: Parking
items.value: Over 230 off-street parking spaces

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Peak season: 2nd weekend of April to 2nd weekend of January; off-peak: 3rd Thursday of January to 2nd Thursday of April
Sunday events are priced as Saturdays
No refunds or delays for bad weather; castle/gazebo ceremonies move indoors
With an outside cake, a cake stand and cutting set can be rented
Prices not guaranteed until the deposit is paid

items.label: Contact
items.value:
Phone/Text: 801-899-9483
Email: info@castleparkevents.com

items.label: Website
items.value: https://castleparkevents.com/
